meta.description: Firm-specific, dated rules read from each firm's own pages (FE-34). null = not confirmed; never filled from memory. basis: official = fetched official pages; excerpt = excerpts of official pages only; none = nothing verifiable.

apex-trader-funding.name: Apex Trader Funding
apex-trader-funding.status_note: Official help-center pages (Apex 3.0 / Legacy PA articles) are live; most official pages returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher, so only search excerpts of official pages were read.
apex-trader-funding.automation_note: Automation prohibited on funded PA and Live accounts (AI, bots, algorithms, fully automated systems, HFT); semi-automation of a manually opened position (brackets, trailing stops) allowed.
apex-trader-funding.copy_trading_note: Copying allowed only if user manually places each order in one originating account and replicates to own accounts; PA must be traded only by the account holder.
apex-trader-funding.pmt_cannot_note: Apex prohibits bot and fully automated order placement on funded PA and Live accounts, so PickMyTrade webhook orders should not be used there; evaluation-account rules were not confirmed.

topstep.name: Topstep
topstep.status_note: Help center and program pages live; Trading Combine, Express Funded Account (Standard and Consistency) and Live Funded Account described.
topstep.daily_loss: Optional on Express Funded Accounts; Live Funded Account has a Daily Loss Limit
topstep.consistency_rule: Combine: best day below 55% of profit target. XFA Consistency path: 40% target; Standard path: 5 winning days of $150+
topstep.min_trading_days: Combine: can pass in as few as 2 days; XFA Consistency path: 3 days
topstep.automation_note: Custom bots allowed via TopstepX/ProjectX API, but HFT is prohibited and orders must originate from your personal device; VPS, VPN or remote servers may not place orders.
topstep.copy_trading_note: Trade copier reported available for Combine and XFA accounts, not Live Funded (search excerpt of official help center).
topstep.pmt_cannot_note: Topstep bans placing orders from VPS/VPN/remote servers and HFT; cloud-hosted webhook execution may conflict with the personal-device requirement. Not reachable via MT4/MT5.

take-profit-trader.name: Take Profit Trader
take-profit-trader.status_note: Official site shows Test, PRO and PRO+ programs; help-center pages returned HTTP 403, so rules come from the homepage and search excerpts of official help pages.

max_loss.value: PRO+: end-of-day drawdown

take-profit-trader.automation_note: Universal Trading Policies (search excerpt): automated systems, bots and algorithmic execution tools not permitted; all trades must be placed manually. Applies to Test, PRO, PRO+.
take-profit-trader.copy_trading_note: Trade Copier Policy excerpt: copiers allowed only across accounts you own and control, using approved copiers.
take-profit-trader.pmt_cannot_note: Firm rules prohibit automated/bot order placement, so PickMyTrade webhook orders are not permitted even though Tradovate/Rithmic connectivity exists.

tradeify.name: Tradeify
tradeify.status_note: Homepage and Funded Trader Agreement live; Growth, Select and Lightning programs listed. Help-center rule pages returned HTTP 403.

max_loss.value: End-of-day drawdown (homepage; amounts not confirmed)

tradeify.consistency_rule: Homepage: 35% on Growth/Select funded accounts; none stated for Lightning
tradeify.automation_note: Agreement s.6.6: bots allowed only if trader is sole owner of the strategy and no one else has access; HFT bots prohibited. s.6.8: 50%+ of profit must come from trades held over 10 seconds.
tradeify.copy_trading_note: Agreement s.6.7 text read as prohibiting copying between accounts; a help-center excerpt says own accounts are allowed. Conflicting, unresolved.
tradeify.pmt_cannot_note: Bot use must be self-owned and not HFT; microscalping rule applies. Webhook orders are permitted only if these conditions are met.

leeloo-trading.name: Leeloo Trading
leeloo-trading.status_note: Official site and support portal live; offers Practice and Performance Accounts with monthly subscriptions.

programs.name: Practice Accounts to Performance Accounts
programs.fee: Aspire $250 up to Explode $850 (homepage table); PA $88/month

max_loss.value: e.g. $1,500 trailing on $25K Aspire

leeloo-trading.consistency_rule: Daily profit in a PA should not exceed 30% of net profit; flipping on under 5% of days
leeloo-trading.automation_note: Full automation (auto-entry and auto-exit) not allowed; any system placing or managing trades without manual input is prohibited on Practice and Performance Accounts.
leeloo-trading.copy_trading_note: Copying another person's trades, copier tools and external signal bots are not allowed; manual trades from alerts are fine.
leeloo-trading.pmt_cannot_note: Leeloo prohibits fully automated order placement, so PickMyTrade webhook orders are not allowed on Practice or Performance Accounts.

fundednext.name: FundedNext
fundednext.status_note: Official futures site and help center are live and list active Futures challenges (Flex, Legacy, Rapid, Bolt).
fundednext.daily_loss: Flex/Legacy: none; Rapid Daily: mandatory ($500/$1,000/$1,250 for 25K/50K/100K); Rapid Pro: optional add-on

max_loss.value: Trailing on highest end-of-day balance (e.g. $1,500 on Flex 50K)

fundednext.consistency_rule: Flex and Legacy: 40% of profit target per day; Rapid: none during challenge
fundednext.automation_note: Help center: EAs, bots and automated systems allowed in challenge and funded phases; no setup support. Latency abuse, order flooding, latency arbitrage, spoofing, layering, grid trading prohibited; micro-scalping under 10s limited if 40%+ of trades/profit. Terms say firm may ask to see the system.
fundednext.copy_trading_note: Copying between accounts registered to the same trader allowed; copying others, group or coordinated trading prohibited.
fundednext.pmt_cannot_note: NinjaTrader-only or TradingView-only accounts are not reachable by PickMyTrade; use the Tradovate connection. Latency-sensitive or order-flooding strategies are prohibited by the firm.

myfundedfx.name: MyFundedFX
myfundedfx.status_note: myfundedfx.com redirects (302) to seacrestmarkets.io, which states 'Seacrest Markets is no longer operating'; MyFundedFX is not named on that page and no successor program was found.
myfundedfx.pmt_cannot_note: No operating official site found, so no accounts to automate.

ftmo.name: FTMO
ftmo.status_note: Official site lists active Forex/CFD 1-Step and 2-Step programs plus a Futures offering (Growth and Pro).
ftmo.daily_loss: 2-Step: 5% of initial capital; 1-Step: 3%; Futures Pro: $1,000-$2,000; Futures Growth: none in evaluation (soft limit when funded)

max_loss.value: 2-Step: 10% static; 1-Step: 10% EOD trailing; Futures: EOD trailing $2,000-$5,000

ftmo.consistency_rule: 1-Step: best day max 50% of positive days' profit; Futures Growth 40%, Pro 50% best-day rule; 2-Step: none stated
ftmo.automation_note: FAQ states algorithmic trading and EAs are permitted if trading stays realistic and replicable live. Third-party EAs risk breaching max capital allocation per strategy; limits of 200 orders at a time and 2,000 requests/day; hyperactive EAs may be forbidden.
ftmo.copy_trading_note: Copy trading rule not found on pages fetched.
ftmo.pmt_cannot_note: MT4/MT5 accounts cannot be automated by PickMyTrade; only cTrader accounts. Futures account platform connection not confirmed on pages read.

fundingpips.name: FundingPips
fundingpips.status_note: Official help center articles (via search listing) show current programs (2 Step Pro, 1 Step Flex, Zero, Monthly Competition); official pages returned HTTP 403/429 on fetch so details are limited.
fundingpips.automation_note: Per help center excerpt: third-party EAs only as trade/risk manager; own EAs allowed full automation with proof of ownership; 1K Instant allows third-party EAs/copiers; Monthly Competition bans all EAs. HFT, latency arb, server spamming, tick scalping banned.
fundingpips.copy_trading_note: Copy trading between different users' accounts and third-party account management prohibited (excerpt).
fundingpips.pmt_cannot_note: Platforms not confirmed from official page; forex accounts on MT4/MT5/DXTrade cannot be automated by PickMyTrade. Third-party webhook automation is disallowed on most programs, which restrict third-party EAs to trade/risk management.

the5ers.name: The5%ers
the5ers.status_note: Official site live (operating since 2016 per its own text) with CFD programs and a Futures offering.
the5ers.daily_loss: Futures: 4% max daily loss; CFD Hyper Growth 3% pause; High Stakes 5%

max_loss.value: Futures: end-of-day drawdown; CFD: 6% (Hyper Growth), 10% (High Stakes)

the5ers.consistency_rule: Futures: 40% consistency rule; Summer Plan CFD: 50% daily
the5ers.min_trading_days: High Stakes/Pro Growth: 3 profitable days; Bootcamp/Hyper Growth: none
the5ers.automation_note: FAQ: EAs allowed only if trader owns the source code; no third-party EAs with shared trades, HFT, tick scalping, latency/reverse/hedge arbitrage, rollover scalping or excessive server requests. Futures-specific bot rules not found.
the5ers.copy_trading_note: Futures: copying own accounts only, on 25K/50K accounts totaling up to $75,000; copying other traders prohibited.
the5ers.pmt_cannot_note: Futures platform connection (beyond BlackArrow demo) not confirmed on official pages; MT5 CFD accounts cannot be automated by PickMyTrade. Third-party signal/EA use is prohibited.

e8-markets.name: E8 Markets
e8-markets.status_note: e8markets.com and its help centers returned HTTP 403 to fetches; no official page could be read today.
e8-markets.pmt_route: Tradovate (not confirmed on an official page today)
e8-markets.pmt_cannot_note: Official rules could not be read; automation and webhook-order policy is unverified.

alpha-capital-group.name: Alpha Capital Group
alpha-capital-group.status_note: alphacapitalgroup.uk and help center are live; the site lists MT5, cTrader, TradeLocker and DX Trade.

programs.name: Alpha Pro / Swing / One / Three / Direct plans

alpha-capital-group.daily_loss: 3%-5% of starting balance/equity depending on plan

max_loss.value: 6%-10% static (Alpha Pro, Swing, Three); 4%-8% trailing (Alpha One, Direct)

alpha-capital-group.automation_note: EAs allowed on MT5 only, for trade management (lot size, SL/TP, risk) with pre-approval of the EX5/MQ5 file; independent automated systems, third-party bots, HFT and latency arbitrage prohibited.
alpha-capital-group.copy_trading_note: Allowed from own/verified master accounts with prior notice to support; copying from other traders or groups prohibited; not allowed on cTrader, DX Trade, TradeLocker.
alpha-capital-group.pmt_cannot_note: EAs are unavailable on cTrader/TradeLocker/DX Trade and copy trading is barred there; independent automated systems are banned, so webhook-placed automation is not supported.

aqua-funded.name: AquaFunded
aqua-funded.status_note: aquafunded.com and help center live; futures offered on a separate site (aquafutures.io), not reviewed.

programs.name: CFD models (Instant, Two Step, Flex and others)

aqua-funded.consistency_rule: Funded payout rule by model: 15% (Instant Standard), 20% (Instant Pro), 25% (One Step Pro), 50% (Two Step Pro)
aqua-funded.min_trading_days: None for evaluations; 3-5 days on funded/instant models (day = at least 0.5% profit)
aqua-funded.automation_note: EAs allowed as part of the trader's own personal strategy and must comply with all trading rules.
aqua-funded.copy_trading_note: Copying allowed between own AquaFunded accounts and external accounts, only from personal accounts legally bound to the account holder.
aqua-funded.pmt_cannot_note: MT5-only accounts cannot be automated by PickMyTrade.

audacity-capital.name: Audacity Capital
audacity-capital.status_note: audacitycapital.co.uk redirects to audacity.capital, which is live.

max_loss.value: 15% Challenge, 10% Ability One and FTP; static in challenges, trailing on FTP

audacity-capital.consistency_rule: none (applies only to free competition accounts)
audacity-capital.min_trading_days: 4 days Challenge, 3 Ability One, 5 FTP (per knowledge center; homepage says 4 for Ability One)
audacity-capital.automation_note: EAs allowed if they follow prohibited-strategy rules and are not from third-party signals; HFT and tick scalping (trades under 2 minutes) prohibited.
audacity-capital.copy_trading_note: Allowed between own accounts and from an external account only if it belongs to the trader; third-party mirroring prohibited.
audacity-capital.pmt_cannot_note: Only MT5 and DXTrade are offered; PickMyTrade does not connect to either.

blueguardian.name: BlueGuardian
blueguardian.status_note: blueguardian.com live with separate CFD and futures help centers.
blueguardian.daily_loss: Futures Standard: 2% (none on $25K); soft breach, resets next day

max_loss.value: End-of-day trailing, locks at starting balance

blueguardian.consistency_rule: Futures Standard funded: 40% best-day rule per payout cycle
blueguardian.automation_note: CFD site: EAs permitted per homepage, but tick scalping, HFT, arbitrage bots and trade emulators banned; futures bot/EA policy not read on an official page.
blueguardian.copy_trading_note: Futures Standard: copy trading only between accounts the trader legally owns; CFD homepage lists copy trading as permitted.
blueguardian.pmt_cannot_note: MT5 accounts cannot be automated by PickMyTrade; futures micro-scalping (under 10 seconds) is restricted.

blufx.name: BluFX
blufx.status_note: Official domain blufx.co redirected to a non-official host and could not be read; only third-party results say it ceased operations.
blufx.pmt_cannot_note: No verifiable official rules or active site found, so no automation route can be stated.

brightfunded.name: BrightFunded
brightfunded.status_note: Official site and help center are live; accounts are described as simulated demo accounts.
brightfunded.daily_loss: 3% (1-Step), 4% (2-Step Bright), 5% (2-Step Classic); resets at rollover 11:30-11:59 PM CET

max_loss.value: 6% trailing (1-Step); 8% static (Bright); 10% static (Classic)

brightfunded.min_trading_days: 5 days per stage (a trade must stay open at least 1 minute)
brightfunded.automation_note: Terms forbid software, AI or ultra-high-speed trading that could manipulate the system; help center bans HFT/bots and systems executing orders with superhuman speed.
brightfunded.copy_trading_note: Terms: copy trading permitted only between accounts owned by the same individual.
brightfunded.pmt_cannot_note: Automated or bot-placed orders are prohibited by BrightFunded rules, and MT5 and Match-Trader accounts are not natively reachable by PickMyTrade; cTrader is the only listed platform PMT supports.

city-traders-imperium.name: City Traders Imperium
city-traders-imperium.status_note: Official site live with 1-Step, 2-Step, Instant and Direct funding programs.

max_loss.value: 5% trailing (1-Step); 10% static (2-Step); 6% static (Instant/Direct)

city-traders-imperium.consistency_rule: Minimum profit of 2% / $100 per profitable day listed on all programs
city-traders-imperium.automation_note: EAs allowed; 1-Step permits third-party EAs, other programs require EAs you own. Stop-loss within 60 seconds required. HFT, latency arbitrage, gap trading banned.
city-traders-imperium.copy_trading_note: 1-Step guide prohibits copying from signal providers and sharing EAs with others.
city-traders-imperium.pmt_cannot_note: CTI offers MT5 and Match-Trader; Match-Trader is a PMT route, but whether webhook-placed orders and copying of external signals are accepted is not stated, and MT5 is not supported by PMT.

for-traders.name: For Traders
for-traders.status_note: Official site live; describes itself as a SaaS educational trading simulation and evaluation company founded 2023.

max_loss.value: 6% trailing (Fast, Instant, Pay After Pass); 6% static (Fast Pro)

for-traders.consistency_rule: 20% best-day on Fast master account; 15% on instant accounts per search snippet only (not confirmed)
for-traders.automation_note: Forbidden list bans automated bots and software executing trades without direct decision at execution time; also bans arbitrage, HFT (5-second minimum hold), grid, tick scalping, martingale.
for-traders.copy_trading_note: Inbound copy trading into For Traders accounts is prohibited; copying outward to own external accounts is allowed (help center).
for-traders.pmt_cannot_note: Bot or webhook-placed orders are prohibited by For Traders rules, so PickMyTrade should not be used to place trades on its accounts even via TradeLocker or cTrader.

funded-trading-plus.name: Funded Trading Plus
funded-trading-plus.status_note: Official site and help center live; some older programs (e.g. Experienced Trader) are marked legacy.

max_loss.value: 8% static (2-Step Classic)

funded-trading-plus.consistency_rule: 50% on FT+ Trader simulated live account (2-Step Classic)
funded-trading-plus.automation_note: Official trading-rules page fetched does not state an EA policy; search snippet of help center says EAs allowed without arbitrage, not confirmed on a fetched page.
funded-trading-plus.copy_trading_note: Copy trading allowed between your own accounts only; copying others or letting others copy you is prohibited.
funded-trading-plus.pmt_cannot_note: MT5, DXtrade and cTrader are not all reachable by PickMyTrade; only Match-Trader or cTrader accounts could be connected, and EA/webhook policy is unconfirmed.

funder-pro.name: FunderPro
funder-pro.status_note: Official site live with challenge, rules and terms pages.

programs.name: Pro (2-phase)
programs.profit_target: 5% phase 1 and 2 (site also shows 10%/8% examples on rules page)

max_loss.value: 10% overall drawdown, balance-based

funder-pro.consistency_rule: none on Classic; consistency rule applies during Challenge on other programs
funder-pro.automation_note: Site says EAs permitted; T&C prohibit third-party EAs for tick/rollover scalping or HFT and require owning source code of third-party EAs. HFT and gap trading banned.
funder-pro.copy_trading_note: T&C forbid copy/mirror trading or using EAs to replicate trades among multiple clients.
funder-pro.pmt_cannot_note: Trading platform not stated on official pages read (T&C call it a third-party platform); PMT route could not be confirmed. Instruments listed are forex/metals/oil/indices/crypto.

fxify.name: FXIFY
fxify.status_note: Official site live with forex programs and an FXIFY Futures offering.
fxify.min_trading_days: unlimited trading days stated for evaluation programs
fxify.automation_note: Two Phase Pro: EAs allowed only after support reviews the EA; unapproved use can breach the account. Instant Funding/Instant Lite: EAs, bots, copiers not allowed.
fxify.copy_trading_note: Copy between own FXIFY accounts and to external accounts allowed per rules FAQ; not allowed on Instant Funding LITE.
fxify.pmt_cannot_note: Platforms named on official site (TradingView, MT5, DXTrade) are not PMT-connected; futures platform not confirmed on pages read. Instant accounts prohibit bots/EAs.

goat-funded-trader.name: Goat Funded Trader
goat-funded-trader.status_note: Official site and help center live; offers forex and futures products.
goat-funded-trader.consistency_rule: A consistency rule exists (help article 'What Is the Consistency Rule?'); details not read
goat-funded-trader.automation_note: EAs allowed if compliant with prohibited practices; HFT and Gold Arbitrage EAs banned; third-party/off-the-shelf EAs breach; may be asked to show EA code.
goat-funded-trader.copy_trading_note: Prohibited practices list duplicating trades/trade ideas across accounts; copy-trading article not read.
goat-funded-trader.pmt_cannot_note: MT5 and Volumetrica not PMT-connected; MT5/cTrader unavailable to US clients. Third-party EAs and duplicated trades across accounts prohibited; per-account-type platform support not confirmed.

lark-funding.name: Lark Funding

max_loss.value: 7% (homepage example $700)

lark-funding.automation_note: EAs not prohibited, but no public API; connections at own risk. EAs designed for HFT or arbitrage strictly prohibited.
lark-funding.copy_trading_note: Copier allowed between funded accounts; cannot take same trades across multiple evaluations; copy-trading services prohibited.
lark-funding.pmt_cannot_note: DXTrade not PMT-connected. Lark offers no public API; connections to its cTrader/Match-Trader instances are at the user's own risk.

lux-trading-firm.name: Lux Trading Firm
lux-trading-firm.status_note: Official trading-rules page live; forex/CFD firm, no futures on rules page.

max_loss.value: 6% maximum relative drawdown

lux-trading-firm.consistency_rule: Evaluation: risk per trade must be the same % of available risk capital, +/-20% variation
lux-trading-firm.min_trading_days: 29 days in Evaluation (15 for swing traders)
lux-trading-firm.automation_note: Self-developed EAs allowed; third-party EAs prohibited; HFT over 2,500 server messages per 24h forbidden.
lux-trading-firm.copy_trading_note: Limited copy trading between own accounts allowed since Nov 2024; third-party signals/commercial EAs prohibited.
lux-trading-firm.pmt_cannot_note: MT5 and proprietary Lux Trader platform are not PMT-connected.

maven-trading.name: Maven Trading
maven-trading.status_note: Terms and FAQ pages live; no closure notice seen.

max_loss.value: Two-Step 8% static; One-Step 5% trailing; Instant 3% trailing from highest equity; Three-Step 3% static

maven-trading.consistency_rule: Instant: 20% consistency score and 3% minimum profit needed for withdrawal; Mini: 15% rule
maven-trading.min_trading_days: Two-Step: 3 profitable days of 0.5% per phase (FAQ page states 4)
maven-trading.automation_note: Terms say EAs, bots or automated systems are prohibited unless pre-approved; FAQ says EAs are not permitted under any circumstances on all platforms. HFT, tick scalping, arbitrage banned.
maven-trading.copy_trading_note: Cannot copy trade from another individual; both users are breached.
maven-trading.pmt_cannot_note: Rules prohibit EAs/bots, so webhook-placed automated orders are not permitted; MT5 accounts are not reachable by PickMyTrade.

oneup-trader.name: OneUp Trader
oneup-trader.status_note: Official site and help center live; no closure notice seen.

max_loss.value: Trailing drawdown, real-time; becomes fixed once it reaches the starting balance

oneup-trader.consistency_rule: Three next-best days' profits must sum to 80% or more of the largest day
oneup-trader.automation_note: Firm blog states OneUp Trader does not allow algo trading on its funded program. Rules also ban sub-10-second trades, HFT, latency arbitrage, tick scalping. Rules pages do not mention bots.
oneup-trader.copy_trading_note: Copying between different traders' accounts forbidden; across the trader's own funded accounts permitted.
oneup-trader.pmt_cannot_note: Firm blog states algo trading is not allowed, so automated webhook orders are not permitted.

smart-prop-trader.name: Smart Prop Trader
smart-prop-trader.status_note: smartproptrader.com 301-redirects to smartprofitfx.com, an unrelated Eightcap account-opening site; third-party press reports closure Dec 29, 2024.
smart-prop-trader.pmt_cannot_note: Firm no longer offers prop accounts; nothing to automate.

the-funded-trader.name: The Funded Trader
the-funded-trader.status_note: Official site and help center returned HTTP 402/403 to the fetcher; rules could not be read, so no figures are recorded.
the-funded-trader.pmt_cannot_note: Could not verify official rules or platforms this run.

the-trading-pit.name: The Trading Pit
the-trading-pit.status_note: Official site, trading rules and futures pages live; no closure notice seen.

max_loss.value: $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500 (50K/100K/150K), trails end-of-day balance up to starting balance

the-trading-pit.consistency_rule: 40% of profit target during challenge (rules page); not applied to Prime earning accounts per blog
the-trading-pit.automation_note: Custom EAs permitted; software or EAs meant to manipulate or misuse the system lead to termination. HFT and micro-scalping banned.
the-trading-pit.copy_trading_note: Futures: up to 5 accounts with same strategy; copying between challenge and earning accounts prohibited; external copying prohibited on CFDs.
the-trading-pit.pmt_cannot_note: CFD accounts (MT/other platforms) are not reachable by PickMyTrade; only futures accounts via Rithmic/Tradovate.
